title: SYNTHETIC: Large outbound upload to unfamiliar domain
description: SYNTHETIC. Proxy logs show host WS-FIN-011, used by mlopez, uploaded 4.2 GB to files-share[.]example (203.0.113.77) over HTTPS between 01:10 and 01:55 UTC, far above its 30-day baseline. Shortly before, a 7z archive was created in C:\Users\mlopez\Downloads. File contents and DLP verdicts are not available.
